turns.question: Of the customers who signed up in August 2026, what share had bought from us by 10 October 2026?
turns.answer: The semantic layer's one definition is the signup-to-first-order rate (share of customers who placed their first order within 30 days of signing up, counted on the signup day), not a "bought by 10 October" cut-off. For the 11 customers who signed up 1-31 August 2026 it returned no value (empty, no first orders found within 30 days of signup), so I cannot give a percentage. Late: sales.silver is ready only up to 2026-10-03T00:00Z, older than its 36 h deadline.
